\noindent\parbox{\linewidth}{\fontsize{8}{9.2}\selectfont $\Delta$ is the median relative loss change against F (percent); IQR is across registered repetitions. Win and hit columns are proportions; I is the ordinary empirical quantile and O is the finite nested oracle. The $\infty$ column is the frequency of selecting the intercept limit. All seven failed D1 rows remain unavailable after ADMM nonconvergence, even when some repetitions completed. D0: constant-variance AR(1) levels, where the peak depends on the current position. D1: FX-calibrated hourly; D2: weekly-calibrated. The broader legacy menu includes the intercept limit; these results are not the WP3 ratio-of-mean-losses.}
